text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
hypothesis: I have little interest or pleasure in doing things.
atoms: I have little interest in doing things. || I have little pleasure in doing things.

text: Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
hypothesis: I feel down, depressed, or hopeless.
atoms: I feel down. || I feel depressed. || I feel hopeless.

text: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
hypothesis: I have trouble falling or staying asleep, or I sleep too much.
atoms: I have trouble falling asleep. || I have trouble staying asleep. || I sleep too much.

text: Feeling tired or having little energy
hypothesis: I feel tired or have little energy.
atoms: I feel tired. || I have little energy.

text: Poor appetite or overeating
hypothesis: I have a poor appetite or I overeat.
atoms: I have a poor appetite. || I overeat.

text: Feeling bad about yourself, or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
hypothesis: I feel bad about myself, that I am a failure or have let myself or my family down.
atoms: I feel bad about myself. || I feel like a failure. || I have let myself or my family down.

text: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
hypothesis: I have trouble concentrating on things.
atoms: I have trouble concentrating on things.

text: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or the opposite, being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
hypothesis: I move or speak so slowly that others notice, or I am so fidgety and restless that I move around a lot.
atoms: I move or speak so slowly that other people notice. || I am fidgety and restless.

text: Repeated, disturbing dreams of a stressful experience from the past?
hypothesis: I have repeated, disturbing dreams of a stressful experience.
atoms: I have repeated, disturbing dreams of a stressful experience.

text: Feeling very upset when something reminded you of a stressful experience from the past?
hypothesis: I feel very upset when something reminds me of a stressful experience.

atoms: I have physical reactions, like a pounding heart or sweating, when something reminds me of a stressful experience.

text: Avoid activities or situations because they remind you of a stressful experience from the past?

atoms: I avoid activities or situations because they remind me of a stressful experience.

atoms: I have lost interest in things that I used to enjoy.
